stage: Secondary descriptive plan fixed before WTP tabulation; preceding primary outcomes and price-sign summaries already exist
purpose: Translate finite fitting availability into the stability of price-equivalent attribute contrasts on the same released food DCE, without new fits or causal/population claims.
allocation_metrics: finite fits with positive, exact-zero or negative price coefficient
negative-price ratio availability out of all 500 allocations
all signed algebraic ratios when denominator nonzero, separately labelled
negative-price conditional mean, quantiles, min/max for all eight attributes
absolute ratio beyond experimental product-price span 12.5 GBP
price_span: Product prices GBP1 to GBP13.5; GBP0 applies only to the opt-out. Span 12.5 GBP is a descriptive extrapolation flag, not an economic validity threshold.
quantile_method: linear interpolation using np.quantile; no trimming or winsorization
denominators: Each method/budget starts with all 500 allocations. Conditional price-equivalent summaries show finite-fit and negative-price counts; unavailable or positive-price estimates never disappear from availability tables.
paired_metric: Bere price-equivalent differences only where both methods have verified finite fits and negative prices; retain full allocations and paired denominators; no significance test or confidence interval.
interpretation: Marginal conditional-logit price equivalents on a fixed released sample. Positive price slopes have a nonstandard sign under the stated cost-disutility interpretation, not proof of bad respondents. Values beyond the design price span flag extrapolation. Ratios are not known true WTP, individual WTP distributions, causal effects or evidence of superiority.
already_inspected: Primary plan/schema, codebook currency/unit/ingredient rows, method-record header and first available coefficient records; no aggregate price-equivalent table was computed before this plan.
